function.name: check_return_eligibility
function.description:
[read-only] Check whether items on the verified customer's order can be returned, and for how much.

Decided by policy code (return window, delivery, prior returns and refunds). An
eligible item may still need a specialist to approve its refund (refund_requires_human).

order_number.description: Order number, e.g. VX-1508. If unsure what the caller said, use find_order_candidates first.
order_number.title: Order Number

sku.description: Check one item; omit to check every item.
sku.title: Sku

function.name: find_order_candidates
function.description:
[read-only] Match a possibly misheard order number against the verified customer's own orders.

Returns up to 3 candidates, best first, with item names to help disambiguate. Read the
chosen number back to the caller before acting on it, even for an exact match.

heard.description: The order number exactly as heard, e.g. "fifteen eighty" or "VX 158".
heard.title: Heard

function.name: get_order
function.description:
[read-only] Get one of the verified customer's orders: items, amounts, returns and refunds.

Amounts are integer paise (₹1 = 100 paise); *_display fields are ready to speak.

order_number.description: Order number, e.g. VX-1508. If unsure what the caller said, use find_order_candidates first.
order_number.title: Order Number

function.name: get_shipment_status
function.description:
[read-only] Get delivery status for one of the verified customer's orders.

Returns every shipment (an order can ship in parts) with carrier scans, ETA and an
overdue flag, plus any items that haven't shipped yet.

order_number.description: Order number, e.g. VX-1508. If unsure what the caller said, use find_order_candidates first.
order_number.title: Order Number

function.name: list_recent_orders
function.description:
[read-only] List the verified customer's most recent orders, newest first.

Use when the caller doesn't know their order number or has several orders in flight.

limit.description: How many orders to return, newest first.
limit.title: Limit

function.name: verify_customer
function.description:
[read-only] Verify the caller with their registered phone number or email plus their account PIN code.

Must succeed before any order details are shared or any action is taken. The same
message is returned whether the account doesn't exist or the details don't match.
After 3 failed attempts verification is locked for the rest of the call.

phone.description: Registered mobile number as the caller said it.
phone.title: Phone

postal_code.description: 6-digit PIN code of the account address.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

function.name: create_return
function.description:
[changes data: only call after the customer has explicitly confirmed] Open a return for one item on the verified customer's order.

Fails with not_eligible if policy forbids it. This does not refund; propose
issue_refund (reason "return") afterwards if appropriate.

order_number.description: Order number, e.g. VX-1508. If unsure what the caller said, use find_order_candidates first.
order_number.title: Order Number

function.name: create_ticket
function.description:
[changes data: only call after the customer has explicitly confirmed] Open a support ticket for follow-up by the support team, for the verified customer.

Use when an issue can't be resolved in the call but doesn't need a live handoff.
Fails with ticket_already_open if the same order already has an open ticket of this kind.

anyOf.description: Order number, e.g. VX-1508. If unsure what the caller said, use find_order_candidates first.

function.name: escalate_to_human
function.description:
[changes data: only call after the customer has explicitly confirmed] Hand the call to a human agent with a structured summary. Works before verification.

Use when the customer asks for a person, policy requires review, verification fails,
the request keeps being misunderstood, a tool keeps failing, or you aren't confident.
The tools already called in this session are attached automatically.

summary.description: The issue and what has been tried so far.
summary.title: Summary

order_number.description: Order the caller mentioned, verified or not.
order_number.title: Order Number

function.name: issue_refund
function.description:
[changes data: only call after the customer has explicitly confirmed] Refund the verified customer for a returned item or a missing delivery.

The amount is computed by policy from stored data, capped at what's still refundable,
and subject to per-order and per-customer limits. Goodwill refunds, parcels the carrier
marked delivered and amounts over a limit fail with requires_human.

order_number.description: Order number, e.g. VX-1508. If unsure what the caller said, use find_order_candidates first.
order_number.title: Order Number

sku.description: Refund one item. Required for reason "return"; omit for whole order.
sku.title: Sku

function.name: reship_order
function.description:
[changes data: only call after the customer has explicitly confirmed] Send a free replacement on the verified customer's order.

For a lost or badly overdue parcel (issue missing_delivery), or for a damaged or wrong
item inside the return window. Which issues allow a replacement is set by policy.
Creates a new order at no charge.

order_number.description: Order number, e.g. VX-1508. If unsure what the caller said, use find_order_candidates first.
order_number.title: Order Number

sku.description: Item to replace. Required unless the issue is missing_delivery.
sku.title: Sku
